architecture.purpose: Machine-consumable architecture model for AI-agent navigation (self-navigable system).

flows.goal: Investigation context -> seeds/ingestion -> observations -> interpretation -> entities/relations/correlations -> entity_stream -> temporal/invariants

rules.description: docs/platform/* must be regenerated via `python -m platform_model.build`; never edit by hand.
Platform docs exclude donors/ per project convention.
ENTITY_TYPE_VALUES in db/schema.py must match domain.ontology.EntityType; test_ontology_and_schema_stay_in_step.
Correlations are possible_match only; never auto-merge identities.
Entity lists/graph must respect investigation_id scope when provided.

gaps.claim: Rules-of-Engagement sign-off is written to an in-process registry, not durable storage.
The RoE approver is taken from the request body, not a verified principal.
GET /api/v1/metrics returns hard-coded numbers, never measured.
GET /api/v1/dlq reads an in-process store seeded with one fake record.
GET /health returns a constant and reflects no dependency availability.
Operational code creates schema with Base.metadata.create_all, not Alembic.
The first Alembic revision has down_revision=None, so upgrade head builds no pre-014 table.
The control-plane wheel omits context_engine/semantic_path, so an installed build differs from checkout.
search/tantivy_backend.py declares a BM25 backend but defines no class.
services/layer0_pipeline.py carries stub markers and is test-only.

resolved.claim: CognitiveLoop ran entirely on InMemoryContextStore; the fix is a Postgres store.
InvestigationWorkflow/RecrawlWorkflow were declared but never registered.
resolved.note: Present now: the worker registers them. This entry guards the fix.
014 has a real downgrade that drops tables. This entry guards that.

resolved.claim: CI ran `uv sync --locked` and installed no test runner.
resolved.note: Both workflows now install all packages and groups. This entry guards the fix.

resolved.claim: Anonymous requests must not receive an administrator role.
resolved.note: A request without bearer credentials fails closed; the explicit development adapter never grants ADMIN.

resolved.claim: JWT claims must be signed and validated before they can establish identity or role.
resolved.note: Only HS256 is accepted; signature, issuer, audience and time claims are verified before payload use.

golden_path.goal: Full person-background analysis: Layer 0 (broad, efficient collection over Kafka + lakehouse + sources) -> Layer 1 (extraction, merge, resolution, normalization of entity-artifacts and entity-invariants, plus relation extraction) -> Layer 2 (full context engine), grounded in the platform philosophy (event-driven, evidence-first, immutable observations, rebuildable projections, no fabrication).

capabilities.title: Declarative source catalogue
capabilities.why: The catalogue is the input to every acquisition plan.

capabilities.title: Source executor
capabilities.why: Turns a source definition into observations.

capabilities.title: Zero-layer contact harvesters
capabilities.why: The broadest, cheapest collection surface (emails, phones, domains, socials).

capabilities.title: Acquisition worker (request -> fetch -> observation)
capabilities.why: The consumer that turns acquisition.request into immutable observations.

capabilities.title: Two-stage dispatcher scheduler
capabilities.why: Utility/budget-gated dispatch onto the stream plane.

capabilities.title: Durable frontier
capabilities.why: Authoritative queue of work; partitioned, ETag/digest aware.
